capabilities: Sync notes across devices via a self-hosted backend service
Publish and share selected notes from the private service
Sync the vault to a remote Git repository (GitHub or GitLab)
Deploy the backend server with Docker, including HTTPS and registration settings
extras: The author offers a hosted backend instance to try before deploying, though self-hosting is recommended for privacy; FAQ covers manual sync-lock unlocking and nginx upload-size limits; the backend components are separate repositories (obsidian-sync-share-server, obsidian-sync-share-web).
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid hosted service, and users who want to keep their notes on their own server lack a first-party option for sync and sharing.

requires.name: self-hosted backend server (Docker or source deployment)

summary: Self-hosted sync and publishing plugin that syncs vault notes across devices and publishes selected notes to a private server you deploy.
